sentences.text: The relationship between the applicant and opposite party no.2 was consensual relationship as would appear from the records.
The FIR was initially lodged under Section 354 IPC only but it was during the investigation that the witnesses and the victim stated of sexual assault on her after which Section 376 IPC was added.
It is argued that the same is an afterthought.

Even as per prosecution case, the relationship between the applicant and opposite party no.2 was on a promise to marry which as per the FIR itself could not materialize and this FIR was lodged but the same does not make out any cause against the applicant.
It is argued that the applicant be granted liberty to raise all the points before the trial court at the appropriate stage.
It is needless to state that the applicant has liberty to raise all the points before the trial court at the appropriate stage which is expected to look into by the trial court.
The present application stands disposed of.
